youtube.description:
Your first Kiro agent hook in 4 steps

Four steps to create your first Kiro agent hook.

1. Open agent hooks - Find hooks in the Kiro panel.
2. Pick a trigger - Choose the event that starts it.
3. Describe the action - Say in plain words what Kiro should do.
4. Let the agent run it - When the trigger fires, Kiro acts.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/
